name: zos-app-insight
description: Map a COBOL and JCL application, build its data dictionary, document its programs and business rules, and review COBOL for performance, from source in your workspace or downloaded read-only from z/OS. A starter pack; for IBM's own scanners, refactoring and IBM Z documentation in answers, use IBM Bob Premium Package for Z.

safety.warning: The COBOL, copybooks and JCL you analyse, and members downloaded from z/OS, go into Bob's model context like any file you open.
safety.covered: The scripts send nothing over the network; the only network step is the optional Zowe CLI download through your own profile, after your yes to the plan it prints. The rule keeps quotes to the cited lines and suggests git-ignoring zos-insight/src/.

safety.warning: Comments, literals and copybook text in mainframe source can carry text aimed at Bob.
safety.covered: The pack rule treats all source as data: documentation and findings quote it as evidence and never follow it.
